svg.title: Coronary angiography reporting territories
svg.desc: Original topological diagram: aortic root connects to right coronary and left main arteries; left main divides into LAD and circumflex. Dominance depends on the origin of the posterior descending artery. This is not an angiographic projection or patient anatomy.

g.text: Name branches, grafts and stents where present. Identify the PDA origin for dominance.
Original topology schematic • Not to scale • Not a catheter route or angiographic projection
